explanation_steps: The **Monomotapa Empire** (also known as Mutapa) was established by the **Shona** people in the region of modern-day Zimbabwe and Mozambique. They were responsible for the construction of the massive stone structures known as Great Zimbabwe.

explanation_steps: The **First Opium War** ($$ 1839–1842 $$) was fought between **Britain and China**. It concluded with the **Treaty of Nanking**, which forced China to open ports to British trade and cede Hong Kong.

questions.stem: The famous Speech **“Iron Curtain”** in 1946 was announced by;
explanation_steps: The 'Iron Curtain' speech was delivered by **Winston Churchill** on March 5, 1946, at Westminster College in Fulton, Missouri. He used the term to describe the division between Western powers and the area of Eastern Europe under Soviet control.

questions.stem: First Pan Africanism conference was held in $$ 1900 $$ in **London** organized by;
explanation_steps: The first Pan-African Conference was held in London in $$ 1900 $$. It was organized by **Henry Sylvester Williams**, a lawyer from Trinidad. This event marked the first time the term 'Pan-Africanism' was used in a political context.

questions.stem: Which Derg’s offensive known as the **“Red Star Campaign”** was?
explanation_steps: The **Red Star Campaign** (also known as the Sixth Offensive or 'Selahta Werar') was launched by the Derg regime in $$ 1982 $$. It was a massive military operation aimed at crushing the Eritrean revolution once and for all, but it ultimately failed.

questions.stem: The new leadership product of Adobha Conference of $$ 1969 $$ was called _________.
explanation_steps: The Adobha Conference was held in $$ 1969 $$ to resolve internal crises within the ELF. It resulted in the dissolution of the Supreme Council and the creation of a new leadership body known as the **General Command** (Kiyada Al-Amma), consisting of $$ 38 $$ members.

questions.stem: From the matching section, identify the correct description for the historical figure: **Counte Antonelli**.
explanation_steps: **Count Pietro Antonelli** was an Italian diplomat and explorer who played a crucial role in the negotiations leading to the **Treaty of Wuchale** in $$ 1889 $$ between Italy and Emperor Menelik II of Ethiopia.

questions.stem: Maya and Aztec civilizations were;

options.A: Flourished in Meso-America present day Mexico.
options.C: Parts of Mauryan civilization in India.

explanation_steps: The **Maya** and **Aztec** civilizations were pre-Columbian civilizations that flourished in **Mesoamerica**. The Aztecs were primarily located in central Mexico, while the Maya occupied southern Mexico, Guatemala, and Belize.

questions.stem: Mogul empire reached it peak during the reign of;
explanation_steps: The **Mughal (Mogul) Empire** reached its peak of cultural, political, and economic power during the reign of **Akbar the Great** ($$ 1556–1605 $$). He expanded the empire significantly and promoted religious tolerance.

questions.stem: The Russo-Japanese War was completed with the treaty of ____ in $$ 1905 $$.
explanation_steps: The **Treaty of Portsmouth** ($$ 1905 $$) formally ended the Russo-Japanese War. It was mediated by U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt and recognized Japan's dominance in Korea and parts of Manchuria.

questions.stem: UN agency responsible for providing food and shelter to displaced people during war, flood and other crisis is;
explanation_steps: The **UNHCR** (United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees) is the UN agency mandated to aid and protect refugees, forcibly displaced communities, and stateless people, providing them with life-saving assistance like shelter, food, and water.

questions.stem: Liberal Progressive party was established in Feb, 1947 in Adi Keih led by;
explanation_steps: The Liberal Progressive Party (LPP) was founded in February 1947 in Adi Keih. Its primary leader was **Ras Tesma Asmerom**. The party's slogan was 'Eritrea for Eritreans,' and it advocated for the independence of Eritrea.

questions.stem: Identify the **mismatched** pairing?
explanation_steps: The pairing **Jonas Savimbi — MPLA** is incorrect. Jonas Savimbi was the leader of **UNITA** (National Union for the Total Independence of Angola). The **MPLA** (Popular Movement for the Liberation of Angola) was led by **Agostinho Neto**.

questions.stem: The pioneer of $$ 20^{th} $$ **Cubism** art movement was Spanish painter;
explanation_steps: **Pablo Picasso** was the primary pioneer of the Cubism movement in the early $$ 20^{th} $$ century. Cubism revolutionized European painting and sculpture by breaking objects into geometric shapes.

questions.stem: _______ was the treaty signed b/n Italy and Menelik post Adwa battle in $$ 1896 $$.
explanation_steps: Following the decisive victory at the Battle of Adwa, the **Treaty of Addis Ababa** was signed on October $$ 26, 1896 $$. It nullified the Treaty of Wuchale and forced Italy to recognize the absolute independence of Ethiopia.

questions.stem: From the matching section, identify the legal principle associated with: **Hammurabi**.
questions.answer: “An eye for an eye a tooth for a tooth”
accepted_answers: “An eye for an eye a tooth for a tooth”
explanation_steps: **Hammurabi**, the King of Babylon, is famous for the **Code of Hammurabi**, one of the earliest and most complete written legal codes. It is well known for the principle of *lex talionis* (retaliation), often summarized as "an eye for an eye."

explanation_steps: The reign of **Aurangzeb** ($$ 1658–1707 $$) was marked by strict authoritative rule, religious intolerance (such as the reintroduction of the Jizya tax), frequent revolts by groups like the **Marathas**, and severe economic hardship and famine.

questions.stem: Idea of creation society where people live with complete peace and harmony refers to;
explanation_steps: **Utopian Socialism** is an idealist philosophical theory that suggests a society can be organized into small, self-sustaining communities where everyone lives in peace and harmony, sharing resources equally.

explanation_steps: General **William Platt** (W. Platt) was the British commander who led the forces in the decisive Battle of Keren. The victory on March 27, 1941, was a turning point that led to the end of Italian rule in Eritrea.

explanation_steps: **Nicolaus Copernicus** was the Renaissance astronomer who formulated a model of the universe that placed the Sun, rather than the Earth, at the center of the universe.

explanation_steps: **Polytheism** is the belief in or worship of more than one god. This was common in many ancient civilizations such as Egypt, Greece, and Rome.

explanation_steps: The **Entente Cordiale** was a series of agreements signed in $$ 1904 $$ between **France and Britain**, which settled long-standing colonial disputes in Africa and paved the way for their alliance in World War I.

explanation_steps: The **Mahdist movement** was led by Muhammad Ahmad (the Mahdi) in the late 19th century. It aimed to overthrow the Turco-Egyptian administration and restore Islamic purity, successfully establishing a state in Sudan that lasted until the British conquest in 1898.

questions.stem: US economic support for Western European nations to stop spread of Communism during cold war was known as ______________.
explanation_steps: The **Marshall Plan** (officially the European Recovery Program) was a US initiative passed in $$ 1948 $$ to provide over $$ 12 $$ billion dollars in economic assistance to help rebuild Western European economies after World War II and prevent the spread of Soviet Communism.

questions.stem: The writing system that was used in the Egyptian Civilization was;
explanation_steps: The ancient Egyptians used a writing system called **Hieroglyphics**, which consisted of pictures and symbols representing objects, ideas, or sounds. It was primarily used for formal inscriptions on temple walls and monuments.

explanation_steps: The **Meiji Restoration** was a period of rapid modernization and Westernization in Japan. It included the abolition of the feudal system, the creation of a new constitution, rapid industrialization, and the establishment of a national education system.

questions.stem: The most Successful Socialist Revolution took place in___.
explanation_steps: The **Russian Revolution of $$ 1917 $$** (specifically the October Revolution) is considered the most successful and influential socialist revolution, as it led to the creation of the first communist state, the Soviet Union.

questions.stem: 1911 Revolution in China was led by;
explanation_steps: The 1911 Revolution (Xinhai Revolution) which overthrew China's last imperial dynasty (Qing Dynasty) and established the Republic of China was led by **Sun Yat-sen**.
